close_reason: Already fixed by bd:JMAP-qz9v.4 close (commit 7449bc7). The apply_jmap_patch function was rewritten from the Vec<String>-allocating iterative form to a recursive form (src/card.rs:362-391) that calls path.find('/') and slices &path[..slash] / &path[slash+1..] without collecting a Vec. decode_segment is called only on actual segments (head and leaf), never on the full path. Both idiom concerns (per-segment String allocation; verbose 'all but the last segment' walk) evaporate with the recursive form. Verified at HEAD via grep — no Vec<String>, no parts.last, no parts.split_last in card.rs. The bead's parenthetical 'this finding becomes moot if .10 lands' applies similarly via .4.
description:
card.rs:292-339. apply_jmap_patch collects path segments into Vec<String>:

    let parts: Vec<String> = path.split('/').map(decode_segment).collect();

then takes parts.last().cloned() and slices &parts[..parts.len() - 1].

Two idiom problems:

1. decode_segment returns a String even for segments that contain no ~0 or ~1 escapes. Most JMAP patch paths are simple property names (e.g. "name", "addressBookIds", "addresses/work") with no escapes. The non-escape case should return Cow::Borrowed(s); the escape case Cow::Owned(s.replace(...)). Allocating a fresh String for every segment, escaped or not, is wasteful.

2. The "all but the last segment" walk is the textbook split_last() use case:

    let Some((leaf, parents)) = parts.split_last() else { return; };
    for seg in parents { ... }

vs the current code which clones the last segment and re-slices the vector with parts[..parts.len() - 1].

Engineering cost: every /copy patch path triggers per-segment String allocation. Distinct from the correctness bugs already filed under .4 (data destruction on non-object intermediates, array indexing missing) — this is purely about the shape of the helper.

Note the duplicate-helper finding .10 already covers replacing the whole function with the shared jmap-server json_merge_patch. If that propagation lands, this finding becomes moot.
title: apply_jmap_patch allocates Vec<String> for path segments where &str borrows would do
